text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer training camp has arrived at last.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In addition to training, there are also
plenty of events happening—everything
from a beach day to a fireworks show...
The
school even planned a barbecue.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm off, so time me, okay?
...Hey, you
listening?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tch.
Sit in the shade while you time me.
And drink some water. I
don't want to have
to redo my laps 'cause you passed out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'd like to think Air Shakur and I have grown closer since the beginning. But whether or not she trusts me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Well, summer is always jam-packed with
events, so this is the perfect
time to
deepen our bond!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Or at least, that's what I had hoped...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A day at the beach? Unless it's for
training, no way am I spending
time in this
heat.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A fireworks show? What a lame, loud, and
illogical idea. Pass.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Not happening.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're inviting me to the school barbecue.
It's so obvious. What's next, the pool?
Camping? Get your summer-loving head
out of the
clouds, moooron.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I know you're up to something, so give it
up. I'm not doing anything
outside of
training.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
All that cheerful laughter is just
noise to
me, plain and simple. You
should know
that by now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's true that Air Shakur doesn't like
noisy
places. Perhaps I should
have considered
that when finding events to invite her to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Surely there must be a summer activity Air
Shakur would like... As I stare ahead in
thought, a spark of light flutters in the
distance, before
disappearing again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching the fireflies would make the
perfect peaceful summer
activity! One that
I'm sure Air Shakur will enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that,
I head in the direction I saw the
firefly, and my nights
spent searching for
their gathering space begin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, it's been days since then,
and my search has yet to
prove fruitful...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I start to wonder if I was seeing things
that
day. This river looks
perfect for fireflies,
but I've yet to see a single one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as I begin to think it better to
give up
for this year, I feel a hand
on my shoulder.

Stop right there, stranger. Let's see some
ID... That reminds me, I've
gotten reports
of a weirdo stalking the woods late at
night.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Goootcha.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You've been acting weird all day. You
think I wouldn't notice?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Now, what're you up to?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I'd better fess up...
I explain my
quest for fireflies and the
reason behind it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Now it's fireflies, huh? I thought you'd
been too quiet lately... When
are you
gonna learn?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I thought I told you.
I don't need all this
buddy-buddy stuff. I
already—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I don't get it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I don't get it. If you know, then why can't you just accept it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
At first,
I thought it was pity or a sense of
superiority, but I don't think
that's it. It's
something else.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So why do all this? Conviction? A sense of
duty? Some weird new
training technique
I'm unaware of?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The answer comes to me surprisingly quick.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that I know Air Shakur already
has the perfect partner in her PC. No
doubt that's the reason she was able to
get this far without
trouble.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But if she continues to avoid relying on others, I can't help but worry about what will happen when she does encounter trouble she can't handle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she pushes people away even then,
whatever that trouble is, it
could stop her
in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ha...
So this improbable possibility you've
come up with is the reason
you've been
inviting me to every little thing?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You got us kicked out of a net cafe,
inserted yourself into my
shopping... and
wandered around in the dark hunting bugs
for that?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What were you going to do if this pissed me off more? It would've ended in a lot more than me pushing you away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Shakur is anything but timid. If I really made her mad, she would have simply found another trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh... So annoying.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You talk like you know what you're doing,
yet here you are, worrying
about
something that isn't even guaranteed to
happen.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's so illogical.
Just like everything you do.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...And fireflies prefer darker places than
this. The ground is too hard,
and there's
not enough grass. Did you even check
upstream?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur turns and heads in the opposite
direction of camp. For a
second I think to
correct her, but something stops me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You coming or not?
Watching fireflies
doesn't sound so bad.
